description: This file defines a PHP class `ADODB_ado` that implements a database driver for Microsoft ADO (ActiveX Data Objects). It includes methods for connecting to a database, executing queries, managing transactions, and retrieving metadata, specifically designed for Windows environments using COM objects. Additionally, it defines a recordset class `ADORecordSet_ado` for handling query results.

classes.name: ADODB_ado
classes.description: Database driver class for Microsoft ADO, managing connections, queries, transactions, and schema information.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado
classes.description: Class for handling result sets returned by ADO queries, providing methods for fetching fields and navigating records.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the server, including provider description.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using provided parameters and COM objects.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Persistent connection method, currently delegating to _connect.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, optionally with input parameters, returning a recordset.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from database operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the native error code from the last error.
